start: Owner on Today on a Monday; last week has payments, check-ins, a new member and one enquiry

steps.action: Open Today and scroll to the card "Last week at your gym"
user_sees: "Send last week’s money, plans sold and check-ins to yourself or your partner on WhatsApp."
must_not: The card on any other weekday
The card for a front-desk sign-in

user_sees: WhatsApp opens in a new tab with the words ready and no person picked
First line "<gym name>: last week (<Mon date> to <Sun date>)"
Lines: "Money collected: ₹..", "Plans sold: ..", "New members: ..", "Check-ins: ..", "New enquiries: ..", "Fees still due today: ₹.. from N members", "Plans ending this week: ..", "– from MettleUp"
must_not: This Monday's money counted in last week
A cancelled receipt counted as money collected
A member's name or phone number in the message

start: Owner on Today; a new gym with no name typed and nothing recorded last week

user_sees: No "Last week at your gym" card
must_not: Last week's card on a Tuesday

steps.action: Open Today on a Monday and tap "Share on WhatsApp"
user_sees: First line "My gym: last week (.. to ..)"
"Money collected: ₹0", "Plans sold: 0", "Fees still due today: none"
must_not: An empty name before the colon

steps.action: Sign in as front desk on a Monday
must_not: The gym's money total shown to the desk

start: Owner on a Monday; last week has a receipt of ₹2,000 and a plan sold

steps.action: Tap "Share on WhatsApp" and read "Money collected"
user_sees: The total with the ₹2,000 in it

steps.action: Cancel (void) that receipt and cancel that plan, open Today again and share
user_sees: Money collected lower by ₹2,000; Plans sold lower by 1
must_not: The cancelled receipt or plan still counted

steps.action: Tap "Share on WhatsApp" a second time
user_sees: WhatsApp opens again with the same words
must_not: A "sent" mark that hides the card (nothing is remembered)
Different numbers on the same data

steps.action: Import old members from a sheet on Monday and share again
user_sees: "Plans sold" unchanged by the imported plans
must_not: Imported old plans counted as sold last week

start: Owner on a Monday with the ready message open in WhatsApp

steps.action: Read the whole message before picking a person
user_sees: Only totals: money, counts, fees due and how many members owe
must_not: A member's name, phone number or what one member owes

steps.action: Pick a partner in WhatsApp and send
user_sees: The message goes from the owner's own WhatsApp
must_not: The admin app sending anything itself
The admin app keeping who it was sent to
